label: digit 1 input late in original phase (t>=4), strongest when sequence starts with t
explanation: Sparse feature (~0.016% of steps). About 85% of activations (91% of mass) are on input token 1 during the original phase at position t>=4; it never fires at t<4 and never during the copy phase (a few weak hits on <DEL>). However only ~2% of such 1-at-t>=4 steps fire, so it is sequence-context dependent: first token t gives 16x lift (60% of mass), p next; more digits in the sequence, and prev tokens s/x/f/l/y/0, raise the rate. Restricting to first_tok==t gives dev P=0.29 R=0.38 mass recall 0.52; adding the prev_tok set raises precision to 0.64 but drops recall. The largest activations are on 1 in t-initial sequences such as t p 0 y s 1. No simple predicate captures the remaining context dependence.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=t (+6.31), orig0=p (+3.98), prev_tok=s (+3.25), orig0=j (+3.07), orig0=3 (+3.02), orig0=o (+2.96). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.50), t=3 (-3.39), prev3_tok=- (-3.26), orig1=x (-2.30).
